license_required.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

type.quote: The Board for Contractors shall be composed of 16 members as follows

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: "Designated employee" means the contractor's full-time employee, or a member of the contractor's responsible management, who is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: information demonstrating that the applicant possesses the character and minimum skills to properly engage in the occupation of contracting

required.quote: the proposed designated employee shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of contracting

experience_source.quote: the proposed designated employee shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of contracting

exams.name: Contractor Licensing Examination (oral or written)
exams.notes: Required for Class A and Class B designated employees; Class C does not require an examination
exams.quote: the proposed designated employee shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of contracting, including the statutory and regulatory requirements governing contractors in the Commonwealth

exams.name: Basic Business Course
exams.notes: Required as a condition for initial licensure; shall not exceed eight hours of classroom instruction
exams.quote: as a condition for initial licensure as a contractor, the designated employee or a member of the responsible management personnel of the contractor shall have successfully completed a Board-approved basic business course, which shall not exceed eight hours of classroom instruction

required.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

available.quote: The regulatory boards may enter into agreements with other jurisdictions for the recognition of certificates and licenses issued by other jurisdictions.

requirements.value: The Board may recognize out-of-state licenses under universal license recognition if the individual holds a current and valid license in another state with a similar scope of practice for at least three years, passed an exam, is in good standing, has no disqualifying criminal record, and pays applicable fees.
requirements.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth

exists.quote: The Board for Contractors shall be composed of 16 members as follows: one member shall be a licensed Class A general contractor

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Contracting for, or bidding upon the construction, removal, repair or improvements to or upon real property owned, controlled or leased by another person without a license or certificate, or without the proper class of license as defined in § 54.1-1100 for the value of work to be performed.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in, or offer to engage in, contracting work in the Commonwealth unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of statutes or regulations governing licensed or certified contractors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education, suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of the license or certificate of any contractor who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed or certified contractors in the Commonwealth.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license has been revoked or not renewed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board may suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate, to any contractor who is shown to have a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license or certificate has been revoked or not renewed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of unemployment compensation or workers' compensation laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Board may suspend, revoke or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate to any contractor who violates the provisions of Chapter 5 (§ 60.2-500 et seq.) of Title 60.2 and Chapter 8 (§ 65.2-800 et seq.) of Title 65.2.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting or bidding without a license or without the proper class of license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting for, or bidding upon the construction, removal, repair or improvements to or upon real property owned, controlled or leased by another person without a license or certificate, or without the proper class of license as defined in § 54.1-1100 for the value of work to be performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to practice contracting in the Commonwealth without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to practice contracting in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the Board in an application for issuance or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving false or forged evidence of any kind to the Board or any member thereof in an application for the issuance or renewal of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving or considering as awarding authority a bid from an unlicensed contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receiving or considering as the awarding authority a bid from anyone whom the awarding authority knows is not properly licensed or certified under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct during a declared state of emergency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the Board finds any person licensed under the provisions of this chapter to be in violation of a statute or regulation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct as defined in § 54.1-1118, which violation occurred while engaged in a transaction initiated arising from a declared state of emergency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional misclassification of workers as independent contractors rather than employees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any contractor who is found to have intentionally misclassified any worker is subject to sanction by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of State Board of Health regulations relating to water wells
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board for Contractors shall consider violations of regulations of the State Board of Health relating to water wells as violations of this chapter, punishable by a fine of not more than $1,000 or suspension or revocation of license.

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.

insurance_required.quote: Maintains the necessary insurance coverage as determined by the Board

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means any person, that for a fixed price, commission, fee, or percentage undertakes to bid upon, or accepts, or offers to accept, orders or contracts for performing, managing, or superintending in whole or in part, the construction, removal, repair, or improvement of any building or structure permanently annexed to real property owned, controlled, or leased by him or another person or any other improvements to such real property.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means any person, that for a fixed price, commission, fee, or percentage undertakes to bid upon, or accepts, or offers to accept, orders or contracts for performing, managing, or superintending in whole or in part, the construction, removal, repair, or improvement of any building or structure permanently annexed to real property owned, controlled, or leased by him or another person or any other improvements to such real property.

methods_authorized.quote: the construction, removal, repair, or improvement of any building or structure permanently annexed to real property

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: Contractor's name, address, office telephone number and license or certification number and class.

contract_must_be_written.quote: The Board may adopt regulations requiring all Class A, B, and C residential contractors, excluding subcontractors to the contracting parties and those who engage in routine maintenance or service contracts, to use legible written contracts

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: "Class C contractors" perform or manage construction, removal, repair, or improvements when (i) the total value referred to in a single contract or project is over $1,000 but less than $30,000

fraud_offense_defined.quote: "Improper or dishonest conduct" includes only the wrongful taking or conversion of money, property or other things of value which involves fraud, material misrepresentation or conduct constituting gross negligence, continued incompetence, or intentional violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: Except as to contractors currently licensed under the provisions of § 54.1-1106, any locality shall have the power and authority to adopt ordinances, not inconsistent with the provisions of this chapter, requiring every person who engages in, or offers to engage in, the business of home improvement or the business of constructing single-family or multi-family dwellings, in such locality, to obtain a license from such locality.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A license for a tradesman shall be valid for three years from the date of issuance.
